summary: Retest of the iteration_54 HIGH items. Unit tests: 29 passed, 1 skipped, including 3 new tests in test_scene_drift.py (drift metric low for the same scene and high for a new scene, plus render SCENE_RULE/DRIFT_MAX wiring). I ran 4 REAL renders, one after another, with the same inputs as iteration 54. (1) AVATAR + white tee, 41s: HIGH #1 FIXED. There is no rectangular skin patch. Both hands were restored (match 0.91/0.95, seam 22.7/7.7, shift 6,-14 / 6,-35), the tee below the phone hand is clean and the hands look natural. At 3x zoom only a faint, soft-edged tonal blotch is left of the wrist, which is invisible at normal size. (2) POSE SINGLE, hotel mirror selfie + white tee, 41s: PASS. The phone was removed, the scene is identical, the jacket is gone, and the wallet/hat hand was kept. However, the QC call FAILED with Gemini 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT ('qc failed, accepting image'), so this result was accepted WITHOUT QC. Also, the tee is partly tucked at the front and the watch moved from the phone-hand wrist to the hat-hand wrist. (3) FREE RETRY mani_viso, 66s: HIGH #2 PASS on output. There is NO phone (the QC veto caught a phone on attempt 1 and the fix pass removed it), the background/mirror/sculpture/hat/scene are the same as the original, there is no elliptical halo, and the tee is untucked. However, drift never exceeded DRIFT_MAX, so neither the tight-face paste nor the SCENE_RULE regeneration fired live: those paths are only covered by unit tests. Minor: a flat 21px brown pad band was left at the BOTTOM of the retry image (row std 0.7), the same slight watch-wrist swap, and a faint smudge on the door frame next to the hair. (4) POSE GRID, tee + denim shorts, 46s: PASS. The garments were applied, the tee is untucked, the jacket was removed, and the pose, face, shoes and background were kept. The background pedestrians were removed again (minor). Cleanup: 2 tryons were deleted via the API (200) and the outfit via mongo (DELETE /api/outfits/{id} still returns 404).

minor.issue: Gemini QC call returned 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT once (model gemini-3.8-flash), and _qc fails OPEN (ok=True, score 8). In phone-removal mode, a QC error therefore accepts an unchecked image that may still contain a phone. Suggest retrying the QC once on an exception and not failing open when phone=True (or giving it a low score).
A flat 21px bottom pad band (brown, std<1) is still left on the pose retry result.
The watch moved from the former phone-hand wrist to the other wrist (it was correct in iteration 54). The tee is partially tucked at the front in the single result.
The second _image_call (SCENE_RULE regeneration) is not wrapped in try/except. If it raises, the whole render fails even though the first 'out' is usable. Wrap it and keep out on failure.
Not exercised live (drift < 28 on all runs). Consider logging the drift value on every finalize so it can be tuned.
There is still no DELETE endpoint (returns 404).

action_items: Make _qc retry once on exception and not fail open in phone-removal mode
Trim the remaining bottom pad band in _trim_pad_bands
Wrap the SCENE_RULE regeneration call in try/except (keep the first result)
Optional: log drift each finalize; add DELETE /api/outfits/{id}
critical_code_review_comments: _paste_hand similarity gate (<38, open 5x5, core >=45%) plus the smaller ellipse fixed the rectangular patch live
_match_head_colour drift uses the median abs diff on the upper ring after the gain: sensible. The ring excludes the lower half, so it is fine for garment changes
In render, the drift regeneration applies only to the first generation; fix-pass outputs are not drift-checked (acceptable)
The mask ellipse at radii 0.40 with sigma 0.08 still leaves ~0.1 weight at the short-side box border, but the 'near' gate hides it

success_rate.backend: 100% unit (29/29); live renders 4/4 acceptable, with minor issues

seed_data_creation: None persistent. 2 tryons were deleted via the API and 1 outfit via mongo.
